subject: Final invoice & direct debit setup — VAT / WHT clarifications
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudhaven.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: finance@cloudhaven.com
Date: Sun, 31 Oct 2027 08:15:00 +0100
Subject: Final invoice needed for renewal + tax questions

Hi Tessa —

We’re ready to close out the renewal for CloudHaven (PO attached). Before we process payment, finance needs a final invoice and clarity on two tax items:

1) VAT treatment: CloudHaven is registered in Ireland and believes the reverse-charge applies. Can you confirm if Redwood will zero-rate VAT on this invoice or if you require any cross-border VAT documentation from us?

2) Withholding tax (WHT): Local accounting is asking whether Redwood will accept gross payment with CloudHaven withholding local WHT, or if Redwood can provide a tax residency certificate so CloudHaven can apply the treaty and pay net.

Also, we prefer SEPA direct debit for ongoing charges — can you confirm your bank details and whether you can accept a mandate?

I’ve attached the PO (CloudHaven_PO_78923.pdf). We need the invoice and instructions by COB Wednesday so our AP can run the payment on Friday.

Thanks —
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Finance Operations
CloudHaven Inc.

Attachment: CloudHaven_PO_78923.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 31 Oct 2027 10:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Final invoice needed for renewal + tax questions

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — we can get this squared away. Quick answers up front:

- VAT: We typically treat cross-border B2B EU transactions under the reverse-charge mechanism. We will issue the invoice without Irish VAT, and we’ll include Redwood’s VAT/Tax ID. Please confirm CloudHaven’s VAT number on the PO so we can mirror it on the invoice.

- WHT: Redwood prefers not to have gross-withholding applied. If CloudHaven wants to withhold, we will need an official statement of the amount withheld and a local WHT certificate so we can claim the credit. Alternatively, if you can provide a tax residency certificate (or local equivalent), we can often instruct finance to gross-up or provide the correct offset.

- SEPA direct debit: yes — we accept SEPA for EUR. I’ll loop in Monica (billing) and Vivek (legal/tax) to confirm the mandate steps and timing.

I’m attaching a draft invoice for your review (RH-invoice-CloudHaven-2027Q4-draft.pdf). If all good, Monica will issue the final invoice and we’ll send the SEPA mandate form for signature.

Next steps:
- Monica to confirm bank details and SEPA cadence.
- Vivek to confirm required WHT/residency docs and options.
- Alicia to confirm PO VAT number and whether CloudHaven intends to withhold.

Would you prefer us to issue a single final invoice for the renewal term or split it into the committed portion + any usage true-up?

Best,
Tessa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RH-invoice-CloudHaven-2027Q4-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 85KB)

Subject: Re: Final invoice needed for renewal + tax questions

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the quick reply. Confirming the PO includes CloudHaven VAT number: IE3498471V.

We prefer to withhold the standard local WHT rate (10%) unless you provide a tax residency certificate. I’m attaching our scanned PO and the proposed SEPA mandate (CloudHaven_PO_78923.pdf is the same PO; separate file: CloudHaven_SEPA_mandate.pdf).

One more ask: given our SSO rollout delay, procurement is requesting a 10% retention on the invoice for 30 days (they will pay 90% on receipt, 10% after integration confirms). Is Redwood able to split the invoice (90% now, 10% post-integration) or issue the full amount with a scheduled payment?

We can sign and return a WHT certificate after payment if that helps, or we can provide the certificate in advance if you prefer.

Thanks —
Alicia

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 14:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Final invoice needed for renewal + tax questions — confirmation

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the PO and SEPA mandate. Final position and next steps: 

1) VAT: we will issue the invoice under reverse-charge. Invoice will include Redwood VAT ID: GB123456789 and CloudHaven VAT: IE3498471V as requested.

2) WHT: Redwood prefers to receive the full gross payment when possible. If CloudHaven must withhold, we will accept net payment provided we receive the official WHT withholding statement after payment AND a local WHT certificate within 30 days. On receipt we will issue a credit offset for future invoices where applicable. Separately, if CloudHaven can provide a current tax residency certificate before payment, we can coordinate a gross-up to avoid the withholding. Vivek — flagging for any additional documentation we should require.

3) Retention split: Redwood can issue two invoices (90%/10%). Monica will issue Invoice #RH-INV-2027-786 (90%) for immediate processing and Invoice #RH-INV-2027-787 (10%, marked as retention) to be paid after integration confirmation. If you prefer a single invoice with scheduled payment, we can do that too — confirm which you prefer.

4) SEPA: Monica will send a SEPA creditor mandate and our Creditor ID. For immediate processing please confirm if CloudHaven will initiate a one-off transfer for the 90% and then set up the mandate for recurring charges.

I’ve attached the final invoice set for your review (RH-invoice-CloudHaven-2027Q4-final.zip contains both invoice PDFs) and Monica will follow up with the SEPA form.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this closed by Friday.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
